High-climbing and armed with spines, the genus is named for the Dutch botanist P. W. Korthals who first collected them from Indonesia.
Oligolecty | The term oligolecty is used in pollination ecology to refer to bees that exhibit a narrow, specialized preference for pollen sources, typically to a single genus of flowering plants.  The preference may occasionally extend to multiple genera within a single plant family, or be as narrow as a single plant species.
